items.title: The locus of points of a fibre where a finite type module is flat is open in the fibre
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a locally finite type morphism and a finite type module the set of points of a fibre where the module is flat over the base is open in the fibre (statement lines 2675-2684, tag 05P7-adjacent). The proof uses the local structure statement to produce an etale neighbourhood and an open subscheme on which the pullback is flat, notes that the fibre is unchanged because the residue fields agree, and concludes by permanence of flatness. The reduction to the etale neighbourhood is the substance, so the claim is H2.
